text: ADDENDUM NUMBER 1 TO THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE NEBRASKA STATE COLLEGES AND INSTRUCTURE, INC

label: text
text: This Addendum Number 1, entered into and effective on April 21, 2022, modifies the Instructure Standard Terms and Conditions ("Agreement") between the Board of Trustees of the Nebraska State Colleges dba Wayne State College, ("Customer") and Instructure, Inc. ("Instructure") entered into on May 29, 2019, as follows:

label: list_item
text: 1. Definitions: All definitions set forth in the Agreement shall have the same meaning unless stated otherwise in this Addendum.

label: list_item
text: 2. This Addendum Number 1 changes the reference "the Board of Trustees of the Nebraska State Colleges doing business as Wayne State College" to "the Board of Trustees of the Nebraska State Colleges doing business as Chadron State College, Peru State College, and Wayne State College."

label: list_item
text: 3. This Addendum Number 1 becomes effective on July 1, 2022.

label: list_item
text: 4. This Addendum Number 1 is issued to define the expiration date of the Agreement as June 30, 2027.

label: list_item
text: 5. This Addendum Number 1 revises the annual fees paid to Instructure according to the attached Services Order Form #Q-247218-4 dated April 5, 2022. The original Agreement Services Order Form (#Q-76677-6) dated May 29, 2019, is hereby superseded.

label: list_item
text: 6. This Addendum Number 1 revises the Designated Customer Representative to Cheri Polenske, NSCS Chief Information Officer (CIO), 402-471-2505.

label: list_item
text: 7. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain unchanged.

text: FTE: FTE Metric is measured by the unduplicated 12-month full-time equivalent students in accordance with the definition published by the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System.

label: text
text: The FTE fees set forth above are based on typical user usage patterns ("Typical Use") for access to the Service and do not account for excess usage of the Service. To the extent the Users' usage of the SaaS Service, in the aggregate, exceeds the Typical Usage at any given time, Instructure and Customer shall, if requested by Instructure, negotiate in good faith a reasonable price increase.
